latin: Si qua est ponenda figura quarta syllogismorum, illa est ponenda quam Galienus ponit, non quam et Franciscus Maironis et Petrus Mantuanus pueriliter confinxerunt; rectius est tamen nullam ponere.
translation: If any fourth figure of the syllogism is to be posited, it should be the one Galen posits, not the one childishly invented by Francis of Meyronnes and Peter of Mantua; it is nonetheless more correct to posit none at all.
